name: Repeats the user's account instead of deepening the conversation
description: After the person has explained a feeling or concern, the helper sometimes restates it in similar words without adding a new understanding or exploring what it means to them. This is visible in turns such as conv-r13-esconv-train-0541 turn 6 and conv-r13-esconv-train-0617 turn 12. The reflection can feel repetitive rather than advancing the conversation.
